summary: An arrow can now be drawn in five styles, picked from picture tiles: Clean (as before), Hand-drawn, Marker, Brush and Sketch, each modelled on one of your four reference arrows. Each arrow keeps its own hand, so it looks the same every time, and Reshuffle on its right-click menu gives it a new one.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no switch changed from its default. Arrows cannot bend yet, so every arrow here is straight.

try.do: Pick the Arrow tool (A) and drag an arrow across a picture.
try.shotNote: Photographed while the Mac was locked. The window is the real one, drawn and driven normally, with one known cost: colours can read dimmed.

try.do: In Appearance, under Masked by, click the Brush tile in the Style row.
Drag a second arrow: it comes out as a brush stroke too, because the tool remembers the last style.
Click Sketch, then Marker, then Hand-drawn, and compare each with its reference in docs/design/references/arrows.
Right-click a hand-made arrow and choose Reshuffle, then press ⌘Z.
Change the arrow's Thickness, Head Size and the Line and Head colours.
With the Arrow tool held, press S to open its settings and pick a style for the next arrow.
try.shotNote: Photographed while the Mac was locked. The window is the real one, drawn and driven normally, with one known cost: colours can read dimmed.

try.do: Zoom in to 800% on a Sketch arrow, then export the picture at 3x.

evaluate: Does each hand-made style read as its reference (25 pen, 27 marker, 28 brush, 26 sketch) once arrows can bend?
Is the Sketch's dry-ink texture rough enough, or should the strokes break up more?
Is it right that a hand-made arrow drops the Ending picker and draws its own head?
Are the tiles the right size in the panel, or should the five sit in one row?
Is Reshuffle the word you would look for on the right-click menu?
rough: Arrows cannot bend yet, and three of the four references are curved. The styles already follow a curve in code; bending is the next task (arrows-can-be-bent-by-dragging-their-middle).
The Sketch's dry ink is broken strokes and flecks, not a grainy texture like reference 26, so it stays sharp at any zoom and in SVG. At the default 4 px it reads cleaner than the reference.
Brush wings are sized by Head Size, so at 1.0 they are shorter than in reference 28. Raise Head Size to get closer.
Hand-made arrows hide the Ending picker and the line's Ends row, because each style draws its own head and tail. Head Size, Thickness and both colours still apply.
The tiles draw each style in the panel's own ink colour, not the arrow's colour, so they read in light and dark.
The Reshuffle walk (arrow-reshuffle-walk) needs a right-click menu and could not run on the locked Mac. Reshuffle is covered by unit tests, not yet by a walk.
